brandSpec.tagline: Color that speaks your professional power.
brandSpec.logoHint: A minimalist, abstract line-art emblem of flowing hair tresses forming an elegant 'N', set in a soft gold foil finish.

evidence.snippet: Local customers complain about premium salons in Gurgaon over-bleaching hair and failing to deliver the requested soft brown shades, leading to damaged hair and refund requests [1.1.1].
evidence.title: Reddit Gurgaon Salon Hair Color Complaints

evidence.snippet: Gurgaon residents discuss how premium salons are crazily priced and often jack up prices at checkout, making transparent pricing a key demand.
evidence.title: Reddit Gurgaon Well Priced Salons for Hair Color

evidence.snippet: Renowned international salon chain located at Palm Springs Plaza on Golf Course Road, offering premium hair coloring and styling services.
evidence.title: Toni & Guy Gurgaon Golf Course Road

evidence.snippet: A premium boutique salon located in South Point Mall on Golf Course Road, competing directly for high-end hair color clients.
evidence.title: Noitre Salon South Point Mall

payload.localInsight: Golf Course Road professionals are highly busy corporate workers who value efficiency; they complain about salons being overly crowded, pushy upselling, and long wait times during peak hours. Reviewers praise highly skilled colorists who actually listen to reference photos but complain about salons that overcharge or focus too much on filming Instagram reels rather than customer comfort.

shelf.snippet: Celebrates bold, professional women (lawyers, civil engineers, scuba divers) embracing vibrant red shades, paired with an AI-powered virtual try-on app to reduce hesitation.

shelf.title: Godrej Professional #HairForYou Campaign
shelf.snippet: Influencer-led campaign showcasing safe, hygienic, and professional in-salon hair color transformations to rebuild customer confidence.

payload.crowdInsight: Public discussions on Reddit (r/gurgaon, r/TwoXIndia) highlight a deep anxiety about salons jacking up prices at checkout and ruining hair color by performing aggressive bleaching when a simpler global color was requested. Women actively seek less busy, non-pretentious salons that focus on hair health rather than social media clout, and they highly value transparent pricing and personalized consultations before any chemical treatment.

brandSpec.tagline: Color that speaks your professional power.
brandSpec.logoHint: A minimalist, abstract line-art emblem of flowing hair tresses forming an elegant 'N', set in a soft gold foil finish.

copy.shotList: Beat 1: A serene, empty styling station with a plush leather chair and a backlit mirror, bathed in soft morning light. Beat 2: A close-up of premium, pre-mixed hair color bowls in soft gold and rich bronze tones resting on a minimalist marble counter. Beat 3: A slow pan across a sunlit, peaceful wash station with clean, rolled linen towels and leaf shadows dancing on a cream wall.
copy.headline: Bespoke hair color, formulated without the salon chaos.
copy.primaryTextLocalized: न कोई चमकदार रिंग लाइट्स, न कोई ज़बरदस्ती की अपसेलिंग, और न ही बिलिंग के समय कोई अनपेक्षित सरप्राइज़। Noya Salon में, हमारा पूरा ध्यान आपके रूटीन के अनुसार स्वस्थ और सटीक हेयर कलर पर होता है। अपने कॉर्पोरेट शेड्यूल के अनुकूल डिज़ाइन किए गए एक शांत और कुशल सेशन का अनुभव करें।
copy.subheadLocalized: व्यस्त प्रोफेशनल्स के लिए Golf Course Road पर केवल-अपॉइंटमेंट वाला एक शांत स्थान।
copy.primaryText: No loud ring lights, no pushy upsells, and no unexpected checkout surprises. At Noya, we focus entirely on healthy, precise hair color tailored to your routine. Experience a tranquil, efficient session designed around your corporate calendar.
copy.voEn: Bespoke hair color, crafted in quiet luxury, respecting your time.
copy.voIndic: शांत लग्जरी के बीच, आपके समय का सम्मान करते हुए तैयार किया गया खास हेयर कलर।
copy.subhead: A quiet, appointment-only sanctuary on Golf Course Road for busy professionals.
copy.storyHook: An anti-influencer sanctuary that replaces loud ring lights and aggressive bleaching with quiet, precise global coloring for Golf Course Road's busiest corporate leaders.
copy.draftHeadline: Guaranteed perfect global color with zero wait times at Gurgaon's best salon
copy.headlineLocalized: सैलून के शोर-शराबे के बिना, खास आपके लिए तैयार किया गया हेयर कलर।
copy.storyHookLocalized: एक ऐसा एंटी-इन्फ्लुएंसर स्थान, जो चमकदार रिंग लाइट्स और आक्रामक ब्लीचिंग के बजाय Golf Course Road के व्यस्त कॉर्पोरेट लीडर्स को शांत और सटीक ग्लोबल हेयर कलरिंग का अनुभव देता है।

prompts.detail: 1:1 square macro still photograph. A close-up of a bespoke hair color brush with a gold-trimmed handle resting on the edge of a textured ceramic bowl filled with a glossy, rich hazelnut-brown cream. The background is a clean, textured cream paper surface (#f7f1e8) with soft, warm lighting. Exquisite detail of the cream's texture and the gold accents. No people, no hands, no faces, no text.
prompts.lyria: A 2-second warm, elegant acoustic guitar and soft ambient synth swell sting, ending in a clean, reassuring low-end note.
prompts.veo: Cinematic interior video, 8 seconds, 9:16 vertical aspect ratio, slow forward push. An empty, ultra-premium hair salon station at South Point Mall, Gurgaon. A plush black leather chair sits before a grand arched mirror with a subtle, backlit warm gold glow. No people, no hands, no faces. On a sleek marble counter in the foreground, three ceramic bowls filled with rich, glossy chocolate-brown and warm bronze hair color pastes sit next to a gold-trimmed brush. The background is softly out of focus, showing a clean, quiet, sophisticated aesthetic with cream-colored walls (#f7f1e8). Natural sunlight streams in from a side window, casting elegant leaf shadows. Quiet, peaceful atmosphere. Native room tone.
prompts.story: 9:16 vertical still photograph for Instagram Stories. A central close-up of a beautifully organized, empty color-mixing station. Three elegant ceramic bowls holding rich brown and bronze hair creams rest on a cream-colored stone surface. In the background, a soft gold-framed mirror reflects a peaceful, empty boutique salon interior. No people, no hands, no faces, zero text. Safe zone styling with central focus, luxurious and reassuring tone, BrandSpec colors.
prompts.image: A high-end, minimalist salon interior, 16:9 still photograph. A single empty styling station features a minimalist arch mirror backlit with a soft gold light. On the off-white marble counter sits a small, elegant gold foil line-art emblem of an 'N' resembling flowing hair. The palette is rich charcoal (#1c1814), soft cream (#f7f1e8), and warm bronze (#8c6239). No people, no hands, no faces, clean and quiet luxury aesthetic, architectural digest style, shallow depth of field.
